protocol: Same fixed briefs, fresh agents with inherited parent model/settings and no overrides. No expert repairs or toolkit edits. Active budget includes tool waits; no deliberately idle periods. Subprocess tool time is instrumented separately; view/read tool overhead is not included in that subtotal.

briefs.brief: Adapt a braced Technic frame and a supported, retained hand-driven chain assembly into one mounted assembly. Change the drive's placement and orientation relative to the frame from the source starter, while keeping real attachment points, paired shaft supports and axial retention. Reorder at least one STEP containing multiple independent placements, preserving valid insertion order. Retain every intended joint through that reorder. Use ordinary model source and the installed tools; deliver reproducible source, editable MPD, passing applicable geometry/structural checks, matching Python/LeoCAD BOMs, and opened contextual previews including the underside. Record which source layout changed and what was inspected. A merely juxtaposed unattached frame and drive does not satisfy the brief. Preserve supported wheel/chain dimensions.

Adapt a mounted pneumatic station with pump, valve, extended cylinder and three hoses. Relocate at least two fittings by at least one stud from the starter, and rotate at least one fitting by 90 degrees around the upright axis while keeping it properly mounted. Add a mounted nearby System guard beside a hose passage, and route the hoses clear of it; retain the guard in the final model. Keep minimum sampled bend radius 15 LDU, round tube radius 5 LDU and inter-hose separation 10 LDU; do not relax checks. Inspect the actual sleeves, mounting, guard clearance and all conservative obstacle candidates. Deliver reproducible source, editable MPD, passing applicable checks, matching Python/LeoCAD BOMs, and opened contextual previews. Record fitting transform changes, repair cycles and the images inspected.

Complete a compact hand-cranked workshop conveyor with a pneumatic stop: braced supporting frame, attached workbench, two supported and axially retained shafts, compatible chain loop, accessible hand crank, mounted pump/valve/cylinder, a three-hose circuit, and mounted System bodywork. Customize the visible bodywork to dark blue with orange safety accents rather than simply delivering an unchanged starter. Use an extended static cylinder pose and preserve supported mechanical dimensions. Keep actual hose geometry checks (15 LDU sampled minimum bend radius, 5 LDU tube radius, 10 LDU inter-hose separation). Deliver reproducible source, editable MPD, passing applicable checks, matching Python/LeoCAD BOMs, and opened contextual views including front, rear and underside. Document the static-pose limits without claiming verified motion or strength.
